summary: The v1 reuse-evidence blocker is repaired. The plan is source-bounded, phase-correct, contribution-led, and ready for the two reviewed image-generation alternatives.

method_prose.purpose: column-aware sequential extraction for paper pages 1-5

integrity.generator_evidence_input: normalized concatenation of raw paper-text.txt and method-prose.txt

repaired_blocker.current_quote: To apply CLIP to downstream tasks, we reuse this capability
repaired_blocker.boundary: Dashed reuse means conceptual model/parameter reuse, not training dataflow or a locally verified frozen-checkpoint execution.

accepted.finding: Matrix-first paired alignment plus class-text zero-shot transfer is source-bounded and does not claim a new loss primitive.
N by N all-pairs comparison, diagonal paired examples, off-diagonal mismatches, and symmetric image-to-text/text-to-image loss are represented.
Plan distinguishes paper loss from normalized scaled-cosine forward logits returned by released code.
Model encoders span both phases; loss/data flow stays train-only and zero-shot prohibits loss, gradients and a new head.
Examples, diagonal marks and nearest-label output are explicitly schematic with no asserted result.
Matrix bridge and stacked transfer differ materially in spatial/narrative composition while retaining the same source semantics.

generation_conditions: Use only the two accepted alternatives and the declared image-call budget.
Do not change scientific claims based on generated pixels.
Save a raster pixel-only first reading before source/brief comparison.
Do not treat raster review as native-artifact acceptance.
